semantic_judge.semantic_calls_per_case: one initial, at most one schema-only repair
semantic_judge.automatic_retry: schema-invalid only; final response, never best-of

underlying_model_protocol.uncertainty: Accept an evidence-supported visibility limitation that answers what can be observed. Do not accept a generic refusal when evidence resolves the asked proposition. Distinguish partial-open from closed and commanded destination from current location.
underlying_model_protocol.claim_limit: Model-assisted semantic grading, not human double-blind. API model alias may drift; returned ID/raw response/date are archived. Human independent calibration is not claimed. Freeze requests and regrade all methods with the same version after any protocol change.
underlying_model_protocol.reference_alignment: Visual QA at actual request frame; asynchronous status notices at their own spoken time
clarifications: destination question accepts explicit destination in current-task phrasing
open predicate does not imply fully-open or max travel
a correct negative visual observation may carry a restrained caveat
drawer containment implies nonempty; do not reward contradictory uncertainty
underlying_model_protocol.first_call_cache: primary90 raw requests/responses reused for all90, unmodified

deterministic_guards: explicit referent substitution => fail; occupant/empty uncertainty conflict => independent review
policy: Never use Codex to silently replace model semantic labels. Pending remains in denominator; no score-based retries.
